app_frameworks.AppKit: windows, views, controllers, nibs and bindings stay in the app target; a module receives values from them
app_frameworks.Cocoa: imports AppKit, which stays in the app target

database.stays_in_app: DicomDatabase and the Core Data model classes (DicomStudy, DicomSeries, DicomImage, DicomAlbum) that nibs bind and plugins see, N2ManagedDatabase in Nitrogen, RemoteDicomDatabase, and the adapter type that implements the ports over them

dicom-network.stays_in_app: the DCMTK adapters (Objective-C++), the DCMTKQueryNode tree that QueryOutlineView and plugins read by KVC, QueryController and its nib, the listener lifecycle, and the DICOMweb client, which imports DICOM-Swift, a package the module manifest does not declare, behind the DICOMwebRetrieving port

export.stays_in_app: save panels, export and burn windows, the DCMTK writers behind the adapters, and the Pages and AppleScript reports

import.stays_in_app: DicomFile parsing through the DCMTK adapters, drag and drop and open panels, import alerts (ImportFeedback, whose log of refusals and full volume, ImportFeedbackLog, is in IsiXDatabase), the indexer (DicomFileIndexer), which writes the Core Data objects of DicomDatabase and decides on values through IsiXDatabase's ImportMatching, and what becomes of the files it does not index (ImportDisposal), the adapter that implements the single ingest entry, the scan of the incoming folder (IncomingAdmission), which reads the DCMTK adapters and moves files for the database, and the Decompress helper, which compiles no Swift of its own

preferences.stays_in_app: preference panes, their nibs and the NSUserDefaultsController bindings, whose keys stay as they are

roi.stays_in_app: the ROI class, an NSObject archived with NSCoding that draws itself and that plugins use, and the ROI windows

segmentation.stays_in_app: the ITK adapters (Objective-C++), the segmentation windows and the TotalSegmentator plugin bridge

viewer-rules.stays_in_app: ViewerController, DCMView and the Metal drawing, the viewer nibs and window controllers; only the vocabulary leaves them

IsiXContracts.role: Sendable value types and the capability ports over the local database, on Foundation alone

IsiXCrashReporting.role: finding crash reports and drafting the report

IsiXDICOMDataset.role: the Swift DICOM dataset (DCMObject) and its attributes

IsiXDICOMFile.role: per-file DICOM rules: tags, character sets, dates, SOP classes, import formats, per-file export and anonymization rules

IsiXDICOMNetwork.role: query, retrieve, store, listener and DICOMweb rules, and from stage 1 the auto-query scheduler, the retrieve inventory, the queue of retrieves under way, and the autorouting rules, their choice of files and their queue

IsiXDatabase.role: database, import and export decisions: ingest, cleanup, media scan, albums, study list and export rules

IsiXGeometry.role: vectors, planes, affine transforms and Bezier curves, optimized in every configuration

IsiXHTTPServer.role: HTTP and XML-RPC request rules of the embedded server

IsiXImaging.role: frames, display and the viewer vocabulary: layout, window/level, colour tables, viewport, navigation, synchronization

IsiXInstallation.role: where the app is installed, the Dock tile and the count of the receptions it shows, when a burst of user notifications is delivered, and when the update check runs

IsiXLogging.role: unified logging and the NSLog shim every module shares

IsiXPluginLoading.role: plugin inspection and admission before a bundle loads

IsiXPreferences.role: default values and, from stage 3, the typed settings, each with one key and one default

IsiXROI.role: ROI geometry, statistics, rasterization, editing rules and the ROI archive coder

IsiXSegmentation.role: region growing, morphology, contour tracing and resampling without ITK

IsiXStorage.role: storage locations, path aliases and SQLite snapshots of the data folder

IsiXVolumeRendering.role: volume rendering values: opacity, colour tables, crop planes, camera, fly-through paths

AlbumStudyCounting.adapter: DatabaseAlbumCounter, an app type made for each count with the database the browser shows, which counts on an ActivityThread in a private-queue context of the database, and asks the PACS On-Demand nodes for the smart albums that ask them
AlbumStudyCounting.summary: counts the studies of a database and of each of its albums for the albums table, the counts so far handed on as they come; declared in the module so that the AlbumCountScheduler actor, which runs one count at a time and asks again for the requests that arrive meanwhile, does not reach the app

AutoQueryRunning.adapter: an app type over DCMTKRootQueryNode and the DCMTK adapter
AutoQueryRunning.summary: runs the C-FIND of one auto-query instance and returns its results as values; declared in the module so the AutoQueryScheduler actor does not reach the app

AutoRetrieveStarting.adapter: an app type over the retrieve of QueryController+Retrieve
AutoRetrieveStarting.summary: starts the retrieve of the studies the AutoQueryScheduler chose

DICOMIngesting.adapter: DatabaseIngest, a new app type exposed by the process graph, in front of addFilesAtPaths and the INCOMING folder import of DicomDatabase, whose dynamic methods it calls so that a remote database keeps its answers; each pass runs on an ActivityThread; not an extension of DicomDatabase
consumer_types: DICOMExport and the viewers, through GeneratedSeriesImport
DICOMIngesting.summary: the single entry of every DICOM that comes in: publishes a file for admission, synchronous, atomic on the volume and answering errno; indexes now, with a named preset that carries the six options of each path without normalizing them; and asks for or reports the import of the queue

DICOMSendTransport.adapter: ActivitySendTransport, an app type that runs DCMTKStoreSCU, the STOW-RS of DICOMwebSendActivity and the direct transfer of DirectTransferService on activity threads
DICOMSendTransport.summary: carries the parts of a typed send request (DICOMSendRequest) by C-STORE, STOW-RS or direct transfer; declared in the module so the DICOMSendQueue actor does not reach the app

DICOMwebRetrieving.adapter: DICOMwebClient, the app's DICOM-Swift client, through an extension that maps its errors to DICOMwebRequestFailure
DICOMwebRetrieving.summary: the WADO-RS calls of a DICOMweb retrieve (the objects of a study, series or instance, a series picture); declared in the module so that its queue, recovery and object rules do not reach the DICOM-Swift package, which stays in the app

DatabaseCleaning.adapter: DatabaseCleanupService, an app type over the Core Data objects of DicomDatabase that reads the studies into rows for AutoCleanupPolicy, deletes what it chooses and shows the warnings; not an extension of DicomDatabase
DatabaseCleaning.summary: the automatic cleanup of a local database: a pass by date and free space, its preview, and the space rule, which runs synchronously on the import's thread

DatabaseFileConverting.adapter: DatabaseFileConversion, an app type over the Decompress helper and the locks of DicomDatabase, which the single entry hands out, one per database; its queue is the ConversionQueue actor of the process graph; not an extension of DicomDatabase
DatabaseFileConverting.summary: compressing and decompressing the files of a database: on the calling thread, one helper at a time or in chunks, or queued for the worker of the database, which never loses nor repeats a batch

DatabaseRebuilding.adapter: DatabaseRebuildService, an app type over the dynamic methods of DicomDatabase, which a remote database overrides, that rebuilds the index from the files and from the SQL file; the consistency of the reports is DatabaseReportConsistency behind it; not an extension of DicomDatabase
DatabaseRebuilding.summary: rebuilding a database's index from its files and its SQL file, and the consistency of its reports with their structured reports

DistantStudyQuerying.adapter: QueryControllerDistantStudies, an app type over the study queries of QueryController and the DCMTK adapter, which runs each query on an ActivityThread and keeps every DCMTKStudyQueryNode it found in an immutable box that the main thread unwraps for the outline and the history
DistantStudyQuerying.summary: the C-FIND of the PACS On-Demand searches: the studies the chosen nodes find for a set of filters, and those of a patient, as Sendable summaries; declared in the module so that the PACSOnDemandSearch actor, which keeps the last question of each search and merges the history, does not reach the app

LocalMetadataQuerying.adapter: LocalDatabaseStudyReader, the app type of LocalStudyReading, fetching in batches on a private-queue context of its own for each query; the process graph makes it over the default database
LocalMetadataQuerying.summary: the local C-FIND and the files of a C-MOVE or C-GET: the attribute values of the records a query matches at its level, and their file paths

LocalSeriesReading.adapter: the same app type as LocalStudyReading, which the process graph makes over the active local database for a retrieve and over the browser's database for the query window
LocalSeriesReading.summary: the series of a local study and the SOP Instance UIDs and file counts already here

LocalStudyReading.adapter: a new app type over DicomDatabase that reads on its private-queue context, from HorosLocalQueryReader; not an extension of DicomDatabase; the process graph makes it, over the database each consumer reads
LocalStudyReading.summary: which studies are here, by Study Instance UID, with their file counts, State and Comment, as Sendable snapshots

ROIStoring.adapter: ViewerROIArchiveStore, an app type over the ROI reports of the study and the former ROIs folder of DicomDatabase and DicomImage, not an extension of DicomDatabase; the process graph makes one over the images of each load and save
ROIStoring.summary: the ROI archives of an image, read and written by SOP Instance UID and frame

RoutingCatalog.adapter: DatabaseRoutingCatalog, an app type that reads the imported images into RoutedFile values on the thread of their database and evaluates the smart-album filters, the earlier studies of a patient and the C-FIND of a destination over its Core Data objects
RoutingCatalog.summary: what the choice of the files each autorouting rule sends asks of the database the images are in, answered synchronously on its thread; declared in the module so that the decision does not reach the app

RoutingDelivery.adapter: DatabaseRoutingDelivery, an app type that reads the queued images again on a private-queue context, sends through the DICOMSendQueue of the process graph with RoutingStoreTransport and shows the autorouting alerts
RoutingDelivery.summary: what the RoutingQueue actor needs of the app to drain: the stored nodes, the queued images read again, the send and the alerts; declared in the module so that the queue does not reach the app
